title: Deceptive Ores
body:
![Deceptive Ores ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f7d7b5cdc27a733ffc672211c92e5e05835bf42e.png)
Have you ever found a valuable resource block and felt lucky?

In this mod… that could be the biggest mistake you make.

Deceptive Ores is a small, lightweight mod that adds resource blocks that look exactly like the original Minecraft blocks.

But behind this valuable appearance lies a dangerous surprise.

When a player tries to break these blocks, they instantly explode with a powerful blast 💥

This makes them perfect for traps, pranks on friends, or protecting your bases on servers.


Added Blocks

🖤 Explosive Netherite Block
The rarest and most dangerous block in the mod. It looks incredibly valuable… but breaking it will trigger a powerful explosion.

💎 Explosive Diamond Block
A dangerous trap for players who are tempted by diamonds.

🪙 Explosive Gold Block
A shiny block that tricks greedy players.

 💚 Explosive Emerald Block
The perfect bait for players who love emeralds.

---

Explosion Power

Explosion power varies depending on the block:

Netherite Block → Strongest
![Explosive Netherite Block ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bbc8dce4137816942cad4e5d4423cfb38d4d5638_0.webp)
Diamond Block → Strong
![Explosive Diamond Block ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e959a4fe96790deb95990e373a054180d4ee95b7.png)
Gold Block → Medium
![Explosive Gold Block ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/85d85a4fe4c635525b74766cb27b83d5a4d1204f.png)
Emerald Block → Weakest
![Explosive Emerald Block ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0385ca6580d22b2b7053fdede42e8c837a09829d.png)

---

Features

💥 Explodes when mined
🎮 Perfect for traps and pranks on servers
🧱 Looks almost like real blocks
⚡ Very lightweight mod and doesn't affect performance

---

Crafting Method

Each block can be crafted using its original material with TNT in the center.

![The crafting recipe of Explosive Netherite Block ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3a81c5b78e16739da514d23ebb694c27d1a5dd18_0.webp)
![The crafting recipe of Explosive diamond block ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/41bb0b89431e937936171767351dc38b6ad280ce_0.webp)
![The crafting recipe of Explosive Gold Block ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/41483ac091935f0e02a8627d8cc1d8d795d77e6a_0.webp)
![The crafting recipe of Explosive Emerald Block ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0b3e7b64cc2e8b1e8b17b550a23f023e16262033_0.webp)

---

Compatibility

Fabric and Neoforge
